visualCharacteristics.purpose: Staff grid with a contact dialog per member
visualCharacteristics.layout: Floated tiles 6-up/4-up/2-up; clicking opens a dialog with contact details

contentPattern.structure: one row per member: photo | h2 name, h3 job title, contact paragraphs (Phone, Email mailto link)

reuseGuidance: Reuse team for the same content pattern on newly migrated pages; add an option class rather than forking for small visual differences.
